snippet.title: Moylo | Classic Cartoony Game Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4877950/Moylo/

Join our Socials/Discord to stay up to date with the game.
https://linktr.ee/moylogame

Moylo is a classical hand-drawn action game with melee combat and intense boss battles. Animated frame by frame in a classic rubber hose cartoon style in 1930s & 1940s, explore a world swallowed by the shadow of death, master combat, and overcome relentless enemies.

Moylo is a hand-drawn action game featuring melee combat and challenging boss battles. Every character, enemy, and environment is animated frame by frame in a classic rubber hose cartoon style inspired by the animation of the 1930s and 1940s.

Enter a world where death has already claimed everything. Beneath an endless night, dark shadows have consumed the land, and every path leads to a new challenge. Face unforgettable bosses, and grow stronger as you uncover new powers throughout your journey.

Each boss has its own story, mechanics, and visual style, creating memorable battles that test your skills in different ways.

Game Features
Hand-drawn animation — Every character, enemy, and environment is animated frame by frame in an authentic rubber hose cartoon style.

Challenging melee combat — Learn enemy patterns, avoid deadly attacks, and defeat powerful bosses through skill and timing.

Unique boss encounters — Every boss features its own mechanics, personality, and themed level.

Unlock new powers — Gain new abilities as you progress, opening new ways to fight and overcome challenges.

A dark cartoon world — Explore a mysterious land trapped in eternal night, inspired by the gothic charm of classic animated films.


#cuphead #hollowknight #indiegame #rubberhose #steamgame
